text:
Anna P: Quick heads-up — running into routing oddities when both X-Client-Tag and Authorization are present. Some requests are hitting legacy tenant shards.
Jared: repro steps?
Anna P: Send POST /v1/generate with headers:
```
X-Client-Tag: mobile-v2
Authorization: Bearer <token-for-cust-abc>
User-Agent: RedwoodSDK/1.4.0
```
Jared: hmm those should prefer auth context over X-Client-Tag. Are we signing the X-Client-Tag anywhere? :thinking:
Priya: We changed precedence last sprint to honor explicit client tags for routing split tests. Might be the rollout policy.
Devon: That's the problem — canary routing uses X-Client-Tag to divert 10% of traffic for experiments; but auth-based tenant mapping should win for multi-tenant isolation.
Samir: We need deterministic precedence rules. Proposal: 1) Signed auth principal, 2) Tenant headers (X-Tenant-ID, X-Org), 3) Explicit client tags for experiments, 4) UA heuristics.
Anna P: I'd add a spoofing check: only accept X-Client-Tag if request originates from edge (internal) or header is signed/x-sig present.
eng-gateway-bot: deploy-log: canary-split updated -> rule-order changed (author:deployer@ci) at 2025-11-03T14:05:12Z
Jared: Good catch, bot. So current deploy flipped order during refactor.
Devon: UX ask for Console: show "effective routing keys" per request sample and which rule matched (and why) — helps debug.
Priya: Also we should emit telemetry fields: matched_rule_id, rule_precedence, matched_headers, auth_principal. Keep them small (snake_case) for dashboards.
Samir: Agree. Also capture a short fingerprint of User-Agent parsing path when UA used for mobile vs server routes.
Anna P: For implementation: minimal change — add header-sig check and bump auth principal to top of table. Also add fallback rule: if X-Client-Tag present but unauthenticated, route to quarantine pool (rate-limited) rather than default.
Jared: Quarantine pool is smart — prevents noisy unknown tags from exploding a fast path. :+1:
Devon: I'll open a tiny PR to reorder rules and add signature verification in rule matcher. Ping me if you want to co-review.
Priya: Can someone add a small telemetry dashboard card showing "routing mismatches" count vs last 24h? Would help surface regressions.
Samir: I'll add an alert if mismatch_rate > 0.5% for 15m.
Anna P: Thanks all. Devon, tag me on the PR and let's sync briefly after deploy.
Jared: FYI I found two example requests in logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/q/abc123 (linked) — show edge vs direct.
Devon: copying logs into PR description.
eng-gateway-bot: ci-checks: unit-tests passed on branch reorder-routing (12/12)
